nodes.responsibility: Author high-precision arithmetic utility module containing MathEngine class with add and multiply methods.
nodes.command: python3 -c 'import calculator; m = calculator.MathEngine(); assert m.add(2, 3) == 5; assert m.multiply(4, 5) == 20; print("MathEngine OK")'
invariants: Pure Python 3 standard library only, zero external packages.
acceptance_tests: Import and unit assertions must succeed with exit code 0.
